subtasks.details: In the /config directory, create a JSON file that outlines the schema for property mappings, including sections for contact properties and custom objects. Ensure the file is well-documented with comments explaining the purpose of each mapping category.
subtasks.testStrategy: Validate the JSON file structure using a JSON schema validator to ensure it conforms to expected format.

subtasks.title: Define Data Mappings in Configuration File
subtasks.description: Populate the hubspot-properties.json file with specific mappings, such as firstname to applicant_info.f_name and other relevant fields from booking and application data.
subtasks.details: Add key-value pairs in the configuration file to map source fields (e.g., from booking.data or application data) to HubSpot property names. Include mappings for standard HubSpot properties like email, phone, and custom properties like application status or booking details. Use dot notation for nested fields.
subtasks.testStrategy: Unit test the mapping definitions by loading the JSON and verifying that keys match expected HubSpot property names.

subtasks.title: Implement Validation Logic in Transform Function
subtasks.description: Enhance the transformBookingToHubSpot function to include validation for missing or invalid data, ensuring robust data transformation.
subtasks.details: In the integrations/hubspot.ts file, add checks within transformBookingToHubSpot to validate required fields, handle null values, and apply fallback logic (e.g., use application data if booking data is missing). Implement error logging for validation failures and ensure the function returns a properly formatted object for HubSpot API.
subtasks.testStrategy: Unit tests for the transform function with mock data scenarios, including missing fields, invalid types, and partial data, to verify correct validation and fallback behavior.

subtasks.title: Set Up Custom Properties in HubSpot Portal
subtasks.description: Log into the HubSpot portal and create any necessary custom properties for contacts and custom objects to match the defined mappings.
subtasks.details: Access the HubSpot dashboard, navigate to settings, and create custom properties under contacts and relevant custom objects. Define property types (e.g., text, number, date) and labels that align with the mappings in hubspot-properties.json. Ensure properties are created for fields like booking ID, application status, and any other custom data points.
subtasks.testStrategy: Manually verify in the HubSpot portal that custom properties are created and visible; test API calls to confirm properties are accessible via the HubSpot API.

subtasks.title: Test Mappings with Sample Data
subtasks.description: Test the complete data mapping setup using sample booking and application data to ensure accurate transformation and syncing to HubSpot.
subtasks.details: Prepare sample JSON data representing bookings and applications, run the transformBookingToHubSpot function, and simulate API calls (or use test mode) to create/update contacts in HubSpot. Verify that mapped data appears correctly in the HubSpot portal, checking for proper handling of missing data and custom properties.
subtasks.testStrategy: Integration tests using mock HubSpot API responses; end-to-end tests to sync sample data and validate results in HubSpot; check for error handling in cases of API failures or invalid mappings.

subtasks.title: Update .env.example with HubSpot Environment Variables
subtasks.description: Add all necessary HubSpot environment variables to .env.example for configuration.
subtasks.details: Update .env.example with HUBSPOT_API_KEY, HUBSPOT_PORTAL_ID, HUBSPOT_CONTACT_SYNC_ENABLED=true, HUBSPOT_MOCK_API=true, HUBSPOT_RATE_LIMIT_DELAY=100. Add VITE_ prefixed versions for frontend: VITE_HUBSPOT_CONTACT_SYNC_ENABLED, VITE_HUBSPOT_MOCK_API. Document that dev uses HUBSPOT_MOCK_API=true for safe testing, production uses false carefully, and add warning about production portal testing.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify that the .env.example file includes all variables and documentation; test loading of variables in the application.

tasks.title: Implement Automatic Sync Workflow
tasks.description: Enable manual syncing of bookings to HubSpot triggered by user clicking 'Sync to HubSpot' button in the bookings table, for MVP.
tasks.details: Implement manual sync trigger via button click in the bookings table. Use simple retry logic: 3 attempts with exponential backoff (1s, 4s, 16s). Retry on 429 (rate limit) and 500-503 (server errors). Don't retry 401 (auth) or 400 (bad data). Update bookings table with hubspotSyncStatus tracking pending/success/failed. Fire-and-forget with retries, no persistent queue needed.
tasks.testStrategy: Integration tests for manual sync trigger via button click; simulate sync attempts with various error codes; monitor hubspotSyncStatus updates and retry behavior.

subtasks.title: Implement Manual Sync Trigger
subtasks.description: Add functionality for the 'Sync to HubSpot' button in the bookings table to trigger manual sync for selected bookings.
subtasks.details: Wire up the button click to call the HubSpot sync function for the booking. Ensure it handles async operations and updates hubspotSyncStatus to pending initially. Integrate with the retry logic for failures.
subtasks.testStrategy: Unit tests for button click handler and sync trigger; integration tests to verify sync initiation and status updates without blocking UI.

subtasks.title: Implement Retry Logic and Status Updates
subtasks.description: Add retry mechanism for failed HubSpot syncs with specified logic, and update hubspotSyncStatus in the database.
subtasks.details: Implement 3 attempts with exponential backoff (1s, 4s, 16s). Retry only on 429 and 500-503 errors. After each attempt, update hubspotSyncStatus to success or failed. No retries for 401 or 400. Handle as fire-and-forget.
subtasks.testStrategy: Unit tests for retry logic with mocked failures; integration tests for database status updates; simulate various error codes to verify retry behavior.
